description: This file defines mock classes for media pipeline capabilities used in testing, including factory and capabilities mocks, with methods to create media pipeline capabilities and check supported MIME types.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory, used to create media pipeline capabilities in tests.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for IMediaPipelineCapabilities, used to simulate media capabilities in tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline capabilities object.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
